title: Field Scout's Notes
subtitle: The bugs were always a problem
text:
Recovered from the remains of an Unstained field scout found dead inside a tooth geode. The handwriting deteriorates toward the end.

"The bugs were always such a problem in the church, or at least Annetta always said they were. But now, as I lay starving down here, they seem to completely ignore me. I have watched a ToothPeck investigate every inch of this chamber. It pressed its face to the stone a hand-span from mine and never flinched. I am Unstained — perhaps that is reason enough. Or perhaps Annetta was never clean to begin with. Bring one of the creatures to her. See what happens."
